profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Charter Communications
profile.geoLocationName: North Brunswick, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary: Extensive experience delivering Master Data Management (MDM) solutions across industries such as Healthcare, manufacturing, wholesale and retailing. Designed developed and implemented the following MDM domains (Product, Vendor, Customer, and facilities). Senior Software Engineering and data architecture leadership with more than fifteen years of experience developing and integrating systems and software solutions using technologies such as Java, XML, CORBA, PHP, C++, SQL, SSRS and SSIS. Technical delivery leader with a track record of mentoring and collaborating with senior technical leaders as well as business sponsors, and a demonstrated ability to work with diverse clients. Progressive responsibility integrating key Master Data Management (MDM) solutions with data integration and transformation leveraging extensive software engineering skills.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Actively and consistently supports all efforts to simplify and enhance the customer experience
•	Leads code review sessions to validate adherence with development standards
•	Reviews and provides input into development standards
•	Develops and maintains technical documentation
•	Serves as final escalation point to resolve incidents and problems for production applications and web services supported by the team in accordance with identified Service Level Agreements
•	Collaborates with internal customers, technical and architecture teams to solve complex software problems
•	Provides general system users and management with system analysis and feedback
•	Influences system design by identifying and recommending design and requirements needs for software enhancements
•	Mentors and coaches less experienced staff
•	Maximizes the efficiency of the various software systems by implementing, monitoring, testing and auditing new software programs
•	Participates in continuous performance improvement sessions to discuss opportunities to improve processes or standards
•	Analyzes and resolves computer related problems by coordinating with in-house personnel to diagnose and fix operational issues, as well as consulting, advising and training on specialized features and functions
•	Designs and writes programs according to functional and non-functional requirements
•	Codes and performs unit and integration testing of software to ensure proper and efficient execution and adherence to business and technical requirements
•	Codes, tests, and debugs new software or makes enhancements to existing software
•	Follows established configuration/change control processes

positions.title: Master Data Manager
positions.description:
Master Data Management Architect 	 
Working in a global organization, supporting master data processes and cooperating with Business units around the world (Denmark, Poland, UK, India, Australia).
•	Manage master data services (MDS) for enterprise solutions, providing controlled reference data to all systems and users in the enterprise.
o	Create logical and physical data models for domains and reference data.
o	Implement databases using Microsoft master data services (MDS) ensuring data and referential integrity using applicable business rules.
o	Provide integration for the maintenance and versioning of data.
o	Provide integration views and export of data to subscribing systems. 
•	Subject Matter Expert for process, procedures, stewardship and overall data governance to ensure accurate, complete and consistent data (Product, Vendor, Customer) for the Enterprise systems (Retail, Wholesale, Operations, Marketing, Medical Billing, Accounting).
•	Identify system and process improvements to improve the master data maturity, system performance and reliability, with focus on ROI.
•	Provide compliance training to data stewards and business users related to models, policies, rules and data standards. 
•	Knowledge of product configuration management methods and systems, including Configit.
o	Advise Steering Committee on performance and financial impacts of proposed changes to existing systems and processes based on regulatory, legal and business needs.
o	Refine User Requirements and created Proof of Concept documents for solutions.
o	Create feature definition documents to define the design, implementation and testing of proposed solutions.
•	Lead team of product masters, data analyst and solution architects in the creation and secure delivery of a HIMSA product data catalog. This catalog provided integration to external entities and a standardized view of the Oticon product offerings based on the HIMSA XML industry standard.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Technical Lead
positions.description:
•	Provided full lifecycle development and technical leadership; responsible for architecture, design, implementation and testing.
•	Designed and implemented system capability using PL1 to model facility hierarchies for SONET, DWDM and SDH technologies.
•	Created systems to automatically instantiate equipment facility hierarchies based on port assignments within Telecommunication networks allowing for ticket relation and suppression based on information reported by intelligent network elements.
•	Developed IMS Jobs to extract Equipment, Location and Circuit data from the TIRKS databases using PL1 and Assembly language used by ATT (SNET project).
•	Developed IMS Jobs to Migrate Equipment, Location and Circuit data into the TIRKS Databases from CIRUS and Metasol systems within Century Link and the AAIS-DS and BAAIS systems in Verizon using PL1 and Assembly language.
•	Architected  new codeset in C and PL1 to communicate with third-party vendor software such as AAIS-DS using CORBA, to receive network provisioning information onto the STRATUS to facilitate NMA (Network Monitoring and Analysis) processing.
•	Architected  software features using PL1 and C to communicate trouble ticket         Information from NMA to third party systems such as Verizon’s Vrepair using CORBA. 
•	Developed XML Modules within new provisioning interface receiving layer 2 and layer 3 provisioning data into NMA.
•	Developed web based User Interface using PHP, Java to provide web based interface to the NMA databases.
•	Served as Development Lead for several significant system features and worked closely with clients on requirements and presentation of software features.
•	Analyzed data fallout during TIRKS and NMA migration, working with teams within client companies to identify data mapping and software changes as well as data cleanup, resulting in a throughput of over 99%.
•	Created and implemented test procedures.
•	Moderated Database Conference Call with Telecommunication Clients.

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description:
•	Developed new systems features using C to communicate with third party vendor software, using TCP/IP to transmit routing information from the STRATUS to facilitate the sorting of totes.
•	Designed and implemented features using COBOL to direct the movement of product within the warehouse, through the use of vehicle-mounted RF terminals.
•	Designed and implemented new code using COBOL for the user interface to allow the configuration of items, locations and the workflow within the warehouse management system.
•	Maintained existing code on the STRATUS using PL1 and COBOL.
•	Created and implemented test procedures.

positions.title: Programming Analyst
positions.description:
•	Created new code using C, C++ to support the handling of market feed data.
•	Developed code set to support the user interface for Market Feed contract entry and maintenance of pages on the distributed Telerate network.  Coded using C on a STRATUS environment.
•	Developed code for the normalization of Market Feed updates and the propagation of quotes onto the page network.
•	Maintained and provided documentation to support the existing code.
•	Supported users in the production environment.  Enhanced using PL/1 and STRATUS.
•	Created and implemented test procedures.
•	Compiled release notices.
